<TALK 5><NAME 11><CV 10,7>It's you lot...
But you're too late.

A while ago, I ordered all explorers
to evacuate this island.

<CV 10,19>This island will sink soon.
You lot evacuate at once!

<TALK 5><NAME 11><CV 10,36>I will remain here.
To slay that thing, whatever it takes.
<TALK 5><NAME 11>Will you sink with the Fractured Isles?
<TALK 1><NAME 1>No, we'll slay it, we'll show you!

<TALK 1><NAME 1>Please let us protect the Fractured Isles!
We are 'explorers' too!

The Hunter and I
will surely slay it!

<CV 10,6><COL C70101FF>Agnaktor Carapace</COL> and <COL C70101FF>Lagiacrus Scale</COL>...
Go gather them!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,11><COL C70101FF>Agnaktor Carapace</COL> and <COL C70101FF>Lagiacrus Scale</COL> mean
<COL C70101FF>Agnaktor</COL> and <COL C70101FF>Plesioth</COL>!
We'll go gather them!
